payload.name: Stocktwits
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stocktwits connects AI assistants to one of the world’s largest communities of traders and investors.

Search stocks, ETFs, crypto, futures, and other markets using natural language to access real-time market conversations, retail sentiment, trending symbols, Watcher activity, and community insights. 

Whether you’re researching an earnings reaction, monitoring sentiment around a ticker, tracking breaking news, or discovering emerging market themes and trade ideas, Stocktwits provides context behind market moves, not just price updates.
payload.longDescription:
Stocktwits 将 AI 助手连接到全球规模最大的交易者和投资者社区之一。

用自然语言搜索股票、ETF、加密货币、期货及其他市场，获取实时市场讨论、散户情绪、热门代码、关注者活动和社区洞察。

无论是研究市场对财报的反应、监测某个股票代码的情绪、追踪突发新闻，还是发现新兴市场主题和交易思路，Stocktwits 都提供市场变动背后的背景，而不仅仅是价格更新。

payload.name: CoinMarketCap
payload.description: 实时加密资产市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Real-time prices, market cap, and volume for millions of crypto assets tracked by CoinMarketCap, from major cryptocurrencies to long-tail DEX tokens across every major chain.

Beyond prices: technical analysis (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Fibonacci levels, pivot points), on-chain metrics like holder distribution and supply breakdowns, and global market signals including BTC dominance, Fear & Greed Index, altcoin season gauge, leverage stats, and ETF flows.

Discover trending crypto narratives, upcoming macro events that move markets, breaking crypto news, and semantic search across crypto concepts, whitepapers, and project documentation.
payload.longDescription:
获取 CoinMarketCap 跟踪的数百万种加密资产的实时价格、市值和交易量，涵盖主要加密货币，以及各大区块链上的长尾 DEX 代币。

不止于价格：提供技术分析（RSI、MACD、移动平均线、斐波那契价位、枢轴点）、持币者分布及供应量细分等链上指标，以及全球市场信号，包括 BTC 市值占比、恐惧与贪婪指数、山寨币季指标、杠杆统计和 ETF 资金流。

发现热门加密资产叙事、即将发生且会影响市场的宏观事件、突发加密资产新闻，并对加密资产概念、白皮书和项目文档进行语义搜索。

payload.name: Next Stock - Market Insights
payload.description: 自主开展数据驱动的股票分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Next Stock – Market Insights helps users explore stock market data through structured analysis and historical performance metrics.

The app delivers short-term and long-term stock picks, categorized stock rankings, portfolio breakdowns, and educational market insights based on publicly available financial data.

Users can explore different investment styles such as growth, value, dividend, and conservative strategies, while accessing curated market summaries, earnings highlights, and financial transcripts.

Designed to support independent research and financial literacy, Next Stock – Market Insights provides clear, data-driven tools to help users better understand market trends and investment strategies. The app does not provide personalized financial advice.
payload.longDescription:
Next Stock – Market Insights 通过结构化分析和历史表现指标，帮助用户探索股票市场数据。

应用依据公开财务数据，提供短期和长期股票精选、分类股票排名、投资组合拆解，以及具有教育意义的市场洞察。

用户可探索成长、价值、股息和保守策略等不同投资风格，同时获取精选市场摘要、财报要点和财务会议文字记录。

Next Stock – Market Insights 旨在支持独立研究和金融知识学习，提供清晰、数据驱动的工具，帮助用户更好地理解市场趋势和投资策略。此应用不提供个性化财务建议。

payload.name: Bybit
payload.description: 实时加密资产市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bybit is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange. This plugin provides real-time public market data directly in your ChatGPT conversations — no account or API key required.

Capabilities:
• Real-time prices: Get the latest price, 24h change, and trading volume for any spot or futures pair on Bybit.
• K-line charts: Retrieve candlestick (OHLCV) data across multiple timeframes (1m to 1M), rendered as an interactive chart widget.
• Order book depth: View live bid/ask spread and market depth for any symbol.
• Contract specs: Look up minimum order quantity, tick size, and maximum leverage for any instrument.
• Funding rate: Check the current funding rate for USDT perpetual futures.

All data is sourced from Bybit's public REST API (v5). Provided for informational purposes only. Does not constitute investment advice, an offer, or a solicitation to engage in any transaction.
payload.longDescription:
Bybit 是全球领先的加密货币交易所。本插件直接在你的 ChatGPT 对话中提供实时公开市场数据，无需账户或 API 密钥。

功能：
• 实时价格：获取 Bybit 任意现货或期货交易对的最新价格、24h 涨跌幅和交易量。
• K 线图：获取多个时间周期（1m 至 1M）的蜡烛图（OHLCV）数据，并呈现为交互式图表组件。
• 订单簿深度：查看任意交易代码的实时买卖价差和市场深度。
• 合约规格：查询任意交易品种的最小下单数量、最小价格变动单位和最大杠杆。
• 资金费率：查询 USDT 永续期货的当前资金费率。

所有数据来自 Bybit 公开 REST API（v5）。仅供信息参考，不构成投资建议、要约或进行任何交易的招揽。

payload.name: IOL invertironline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your Invertironline brokerage account and trade Argentine markets directly in conversation. Pull real-time quotes and order books for stocks, bonds, CEDEARs, and options on BYMA, with full options chains including Greeks. Place buy and sell orders, set stop loss and take profit levels, and subscribe to or redeem mutual funds (FCI). Review your portfolio holdings, cash balance across settlement terms, and recent account activity. Every order is validated before submission, so you always confirm the price, commissions, and any sworn declarations required before anything is executed.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Invertironline 证券账户，直接通过对话交易阿根廷市场。获取 BYMA 上股票、债券、CEDEARs 和期权的实时报价及订单簿，包括含希腊值的完整期权链。提交买卖订单，设置止损和止盈价位，并申购或赎回共同基金（FCI）。查看投资组合持仓、不同结算期限下的现金余额和近期账户活动。每笔订单提交前都会校验，因此在执行任何操作之前，你都要确认价格、佣金及任何必须提交的宣誓声明。

payload.name: MyInvestor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MyInvestor helps users explore MyInvestor's public investment catalogue from ChatGPT. Users can search and inspect mutual funds, ETFs, and stocks; resolve fund names; compare investments; discover automated portfolios; and simulate a custom portfolio using historical market data. The app is read-only and does not access customer accounts, place orders, subscribe to products, or execute financial transactions.
payload.longDescription: MyInvestor 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 探索 MyInvestor 的公开投资产品目录。用户可以搜索和查看共同基金、ETF 和股票；识别基金名称；比较投资产品；发现自动化投资组合；并使用历史市场数据模拟自定义投资组合。应用为只读，不访问客户账户、不下单、不申购产品，也不执行金融交易。

payload.name: TipRanks
payload.description: 分析师支持的股票研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TipRanks gives ChatGPT access to live financial data and analyst research, including stock quotes, analyst consensus, price targets, Smart Score, financial statements, earnings history and call summaries, news sentiment, insider transactions, hedge-fund and congressional activity, ETF data, options activity, commodities, forex, crypto, market movers, economic and FDA calendars, and authorized TipRanks portfolio holdings. All data is for informational purposes only and is not investment, financial, legal, or tax advice; quotes may be delayed.
payload.longDescription: TipRanks 让 ChatGPT 访问实时财务数据和分析师研究，包括股票报价、分析师共识、目标价、Smart Score、财务报表、历史财报和财报电话会议摘要、新闻情绪、内部人士交易、对冲基金及国会议员活动、ETF数据、期权活动、大宗商品、外汇、加密货币、市场异动标的、经济和FDA日历，以及经授权的 TipRanks 投资组合持仓。所有数据仅供参考，不构成投资、财务、法律或税务建议；报价可能延迟。

payload.name: TradingCursor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TradingCursor delivers structured, multi-signal analysis for stocks, crypto, forex, and ETFs.
payload.longDescription: TradingCursor 为股票、加密货币、外汇和 ETF 提供结构化、多信号分析。

payload.name: FMP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Real-time and historical financial data through a suite of tools covering stocks, ETFs, crypto, forex, commodities, SEC filings, economic indicators, and more. Users can look up company fundamentals, pull financial statements, screen stocks, read earnings transcripts, track insider and congressional trades, and more. Elevate your financial analysis and investment research with trusted, institutional-quality data.
payload.longDescription: 通过一套工具获取实时和历史金融数据，覆盖股票、ETF、加密资产、外汇、大宗商品、SEC 申报文件、经济指标等。用户可查询公司基本面、获取财务报表、筛选股票、阅读业绩会议转录、跟踪内部人士及国会议员交易等。借助可信的机构级数据，提升财务分析和投资研究。

payload.name: YNAB: Get Good At Money
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Worried about money? It might be because you’re bad at money. That’s not a character flaw—it’s a skills gap!

YNAB is here to help you get good at money so you’ll never worry about money again.

Get access to custom tools & expert guidance on topics like saving, paying off debt, managing money with a partner, irregular income, and more—all prepared by the real humans behind the cult favorite money app, YNAB, which has helped millions of people get good at money.

Ask a question to get started and watch your money stress melt away. You’ve got this!
payload.longDescription:
担心钱的问题？可能是因为你不擅长管理钱。这不是性格缺陷，而是技能差距！

YNAB 帮助你学会管理钱，让你不再为钱担忧。

获取定制工具和专业指导，主题涵盖储蓄、偿还债务、与伴侣共同理财、不规律收入等；全部由备受喜爱的理财应用 YNAB 背后的真人团队准备，该应用已帮助数百万人学会管理钱。

提出问题，开始使用，看着金钱压力逐渐消散。你可以做到！

payload.name: CryptoAudit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CryptoAudit: Crypto AI helps people analyze cryptocurrency markets inside ChatGPT. Users can view live charts, check market summaries, compare coins, review technical indicators like RSI and MACD, see support and resistance levels, track market sentiment, spot unusual whale activity, and explore AI-based price outlooks. It is built for quick research and clearer decision-making with simple, practical crypto insights.
payload.longDescription: CryptoAudit: Crypto AI 帮助人们在 ChatGPT 内分析加密货币市场。用户可查看实时图表、市场摘要，比较币种，查看 RSI 和 MACD 等技术指标、支撑位和阻力位，跟踪市场情绪，发现异常巨鲸活动，并探索基于 AI 的价格展望。它通过简单实用的加密市场洞察，帮助用户快速研究并做出更清晰的决策。

payload.name: Unusual Whales
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Unusual Whales helps users research markets through ChatGPT with options flow, option chains, equity fundamentals, insider and congressional trading, macro rates, charts, and related market data.
payload.longDescription: Unusual Whales 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 研究市场，提供期权资金流、期权链、股票基本面、内部人士和国会议员交易、宏观利率、图表及相关市场数据。

payload.name: OKX
payload.description: 查找加密资产市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get real-time crypto prices, market stats, and trading volume powered by OKX. View interactive candlestick charts across multiple timeframes and compare tokens side by side — all within your conversation.
payload.longDescription: 获取由 OKX 提供的实时加密资产价格、市场统计和交易量。在对话中查看多种时间周期的交互式 K 线图，并并列比较代币。

payload.name: PicPay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Conecte sua IA ao ecossistema financeiro do Picpay com segurança, inteligência e autonomia controlada
payload.longDescription: 以安全、智能且自主程度受控的方式，将你的 AI 连接到 Picpay 金融生态系统

payload.name: Token Terminal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Token Terminal MCP brings institutional-grade blockchain data into ChatGPT.

Query standardized onchain financial and usage metrics across 100+ blockchains, 1,200+ applications, and 3,000+ tokenized assets — using natural language.

The MCP connects ChatGPT directly to Token Terminal’s data layer, which transforms raw blockchain activity into clean and comparable metrics.

With Token Terminal MCP, you can:

• Analyze the usage and activity of any blockchain
• Analyze any tokenized asset or application through 25+ different metrics
• Get access to full historical data
• Answer research questions without dashboards or SQL

Built for investors, analysts, developers, and researchers who want reliable blockchain data in a clean and standardized format.

A Token Terminal account is required. A free tier is available.
payload.longDescription:
Token Terminal MCP将机构级区块链数据带入ChatGPT。

使用自然语言查询覆盖100+条区块链、1,200+个应用和3,000+种代币化资产的标准化链上财务及使用指标。

该MCP将ChatGPT直接连接到Token Terminal的数据层，将原始区块链活动转化为清晰、可比较的指标。

使用Token Terminal MCP，你可以：

• 分析任何区块链的使用情况和活动
• 通过25+种不同指标分析任何代币化资产或应用
• 获取完整历史数据
• 无需仪表板或SQL即可解答研究问题

专为希望获取清晰、标准化格式的可靠区块链数据的投资者、分析师、开发者和研究人员打造。

需要Token Terminal账户。提供免费套餐。

payload.name: Itau Beneficios
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Todo lo que necesitas saber sobre tus beneficios Itaú, ahora en ChatGPT. Pregunta por los beneficios asociados a tu tarjeta o encuentra descuentos y experiencias que se adapten a lo que buscas:
Conoce los beneficios asociados a tus tarjetas.
Encuentra descuentos y beneficios en viajes, entretención, restaurantes y mucho más.
Explora experiencias y beneficios exclusivos de Itaú.
Conoce un mundo de beneficios con tus tarjetas Itaú , ahora a una conversación de distancia.
Ten en cuenta:
El servicio utiliza inteligencia artificial generativa. Las respuestas son generadas automáticamente y podrían contener errores o imprecisiones.
No ingreses datos personales, claves ni información sensible.
Itaú no comparte información personal de sus clientes con OpenAI para la generación de respuestas del agente.
Confía en esta experiencia solo si estás accediendo a través del plug-in oficial desarrollado por Banco Itaú Chile.
payload.longDescription:
有关 Itaú 优惠权益的一切，现在都能在 ChatGPT 中了解。询问你的银行卡所享权益，或寻找符合需求的折扣和体验：
了解你的银行卡所享权益。
查找旅行、娱乐、餐厅及更多领域的折扣和权益。
探索 Itaú 专属体验和权益。
你的 Itaú 银行卡带来的丰富权益，现在只需一次对话即可了解。
请注意：
本服务使用生成式人工智能。回答自动生成，可能存在错误或不准确之处。
请勿输入个人资料、密码或敏感信息。
Itaú 不会为生成智能体回答而向 OpenAI 分享客户个人信息。
仅当你通过 Banco Itaú Chile 开发的官方插件访问时，才可信赖此体验。

payload.name: AlphaStocks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze investment materials such as stock theses, earnings reports, analyst notes, and company updates. The app helps users break down investment assumptions, identify risks and red flags, and extract key positive, negative, and neutral signals from earnings materials. It is designed to make financial research more structured, faster, and easier to review.
payload.longDescription: 分析股票投资论点、财报、分析师笔记和公司最新信息等投资材料。应用帮助用户拆解投资假设、识别风险和警示信号，并从财报材料中提取关键的正面、负面和中性信号。它旨在让金融研究更有条理、更快捷、更易审核。

payload.name: PitchBook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Unlock the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and timely private capital market data with the PitchBook app inside ChatGPT.  PitchBook clients can access trusted insights on firms, deals, funds, and key players inside their favorite LLM with our MCP server. Accelerate deal sourcing, company benchmarking, and investment research workflows inside a secure, end-to-end enterprise AI platform.

Uncover new opportunities and invest confidently with the pulse of private capital markets.
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 中的 PitchBook 应用，获取业内最全面、准确、及时的私募资本市场数据。PitchBook 客户可通过我们的 MCP 服务器，在常用的大语言模型中访问关于机构、交易、基金和关键参与者的可信洞察。在安全的端到端企业 AI 平台中加速交易机会发掘、公司对标和投资研究工作流程。

把握私募资本市场脉动，发现新机会并自信投资。

payload.name: Quartr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Quartr helps users research public companies by searching company profiles, events, conferences, documents, transcripts, summaries, and financials. It also lets users manage Quartr research assets such as watchlists, keyword alerts, saved clips folders, workspaces, and saved search filters through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Quartr 通过搜索公司资料、活动、会议、文档、转录、摘要和财务数据，帮助用户研究上市公司。用户还可以通过 ChatGPT 管理 Quartr 研究资源，包括自选列表、关键词提醒、已保存片段文件夹、工作空间和已保存的搜索筛选条件。

payload.name: Kubera
payload.description: 跟踪净资产并发现趋势
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask questions about your Kubera portfolio.

Connect your Kubera account to access your live balance sheet data, including net worth, assets, liabilities, and allocation.

The assistant uses this data to answer questions, surface patterns, and explain what’s in your portfolio.

Example questions:

- What is my current net worth?
- What stands out in my balance sheet?
- Where am I overly concentrated?
- Summarize my assets, liabilities, and entities
- What questions should I ask my advisor?
- Update my Tesla shares to 100 units

Kubera is the Balance Sheet for those who manage their own wealth. https://www.kubera.com/
payload.longDescription:
询问有关 Kubera 投资组合的问题。

连接 Kubera 账户，访问实时资产负债表数据，包括净资产、资产、负债及配置。

助手利用这些数据回答问题、发现规律，并解释投资组合的构成。

问题示例：

- 我目前的净资产是多少？
- 我的资产负债表中有哪些值得注意的情况？
- 我在哪些方面配置过于集中？
- 总结我的资产、负债及实体
- 我应该向顾问提出哪些问题？
- 将我的 Tesla 持股更新为 100 股

Kubera 是为自行管理财富的人打造的资产负债表。https://www.kubera.com/

payload.name: VODER
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your books, in plain English. Connect Xero, FreshBooks, MYOB or QuickBooks Online (QBO) to VODER. Ask about cash, invoices, payments and financial reports in ChatGPT, without hunting through accounting screens.
payload.longDescription: 用日常英语了解你的账簿。将Xero、FreshBooks、MYOB或QuickBooks Online（QBO）连接到VODER。在ChatGPT中询问现金、发票、付款和财务报告，无需在会计界面中四处查找。

payload.name: Synci
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Synci connects your real bank, brokerage, and crypto-exchange accounts to AI assistants,
read-only. Ask about balances, transactions, holdings, and spending across all your
accounts in one place:

"What did I spend on groceries last month?"
"Which subscriptions am I paying for, and what do they cost per year?"
"How is my portfolio allocated across stocks, ETFs, and crypto?"
"Compare my checking account balance today with the start of the month."
"Are any of my bank connections failing?"

Synci aggregates accounts across thousands of institutions:
- Banks in Europe and the UK via GoCardless Bank Account Data
- Banks in New Zealand via Akahu
- Investment brokerages and crypto exchanges via SnapTrade

All connected accounts are visible through one MCP server, in their native currencies.
payload.longDescription:
Synci 以只读方式将真实银行、证券经纪和加密货币交易所账户连接到 AI 助手。
在同一处询问所有账户的余额、交易、持仓和支出：

“我上个月买食品花了多少钱？”
“我在付费订阅哪些服务，每年各花多少钱？”
“我的投资组合在股票、ETF 和加密货币之间如何配置？”
“比较今天与月初的活期账户余额。”
“我的银行连接有没有出现故障？”

Synci 汇总数千家机构的账户：
- 通过 GoCardless Bank Account Data 连接欧洲和英国的银行
- 通过 Akahu 连接新西兰的银行
- 通过 SnapTrade 连接投资证券经纪商和加密货币交易所

所有已连接账户均可通过一个 MCP 服务器查看，金额以各账户的原生货币显示。

payload.name: FinancialFilings
payload.description: 公司申报文件与财务数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FinancialFilings gives ChatGPT access to filings, call transcripts, and normalized financials for listed and delisted companies worldwide, 35 million+ filings across 85,000+ tickers, with 20+ years of history. Ask for any company's latest annual report, pull a specific financial line item with its currency and fiscal period, search a filing's full text, or compare metrics across peers. Sign in with your free FinancialFilings account using OAuth, no API key needed. Built on the open Model Context Protocol.
payload.longDescription: FinancialFilings 让 ChatGPT 访问全球上市和退市公司的申报文件、电话会议文字稿及标准化财务数据，覆盖 85,000+ 个证券代码、35 million+（3,500 万+）份申报文件，拥有 20+ 年历史。可询问任何公司的最新年报，提取特定财务科目及其币种和财务期间，搜索申报全文，或比较同行指标。使用免费的 FinancialFilings 账户通过 OAuth 登录，无需 API 密钥。基于开放的模型上下文协议构建。

payload.name: Exum: ExoScope Crypto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Browse live crypto markets and open interactive ExoScope charts inside ChatGPT.
View candlestick price action, 24h moves, ranked Binance USDT pairs, and recent market events — then jump to the full Exum desk for indicators, AI terminal, and alerts.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: LONA Trading Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LONA Trading Assistant helps you develop, backtest, and optimize algorithmic trading strategies using AI. Upload market data from supported exchanges, write Python-based trading strategies, and run comprehensive backtests to see how your strategies would have performed historically. View detailed performance reports with interactive charts showing entry/exit points, returns, and risk metrics.
payload.longDescription: LONA Trading Assistant 帮助您利用 AI 开发、回测和优化算法交易策略。上传来自受支持交易所的市场数据，编写基于 Python 的交易策略，并运行全面回测，查看策略在历史上可能的表现。查看详细表现报告及交互图表，展示入场和出场点、收益及风险指标。

payload.name: StrategyTune
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.

ChatGPT can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. ChatGPT can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, ChatGPT writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
StrategyTune 是交易策略回测平台，此插件让 ChatGPT 能够直接操作它。

ChatGPT 可以编写并保存构建策略所需的组件，包括图表指标、可复用的市场条件（StrategyTune 称之为信号和过滤器）以及完整交易策略，再在 StrategyTune 的沙盒云环境中，使用真实历史市场数据逐笔运行。简单策略可在数秒内回测一年的历史数据，便于快速迭代。

它不局限于自动策略回测。ChatGPT 还能在同一沙盒中运行自定义研究代码：统计某条件发生的频率、测量特定时刻的数值、收集自己的统计数据，并在运行中记录日志。你说明想检查什么，ChatGPT 编写代码、运行、读取输出，再告诉你发现了什么。

运行结束后，你会获得完整报告，包括绩效统计及其背后的逐笔交易。ChatGPT 还能操作已打开的 StrategyTune 图表：读取 K 线和各指标的计算值，添加并配置指标，在时间轴上标注条件，直观看到条件何时成立，并切换品种或时间周期。读取计算值也有助于它调试自己的工作：若它编写的指标在图表上看起来不对，就能检查曲线背后的实际数字，而非猜测。

一切都基于历史数据运行。此插件不会连接券商、提交实盘订单或提供投资建议。

payload.name: S&P Global - Deterministic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use natural language to query a range of S&P Global datasets, including S&P Capital IQ Financials, transcripts, and more. Designed to save time and resources for engineering, product, and business teams in financial services, this server streamlines access to company information, financial statements, historical market data, and global securities.
payload.longDescription: 用自然语言查询一系列 S&P Global 数据集，包括 S&P Capital IQ Financials、文字稿等。此服务器旨在为金融服务行业的工程、产品和业务团队节省时间与资源，简化公司信息、财务报表、历史市场数据和全球证券的访问。

payload.name: FactSet AI-Ready Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FactSet Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open, API-based standard designed to seamlessly connect financial data, analytics models, and applications across different platforms. By enabling smooth interoperability, MCP empowers investment teams to easily share insights, streamline workflows, and enhance collaboration regardless of their tools or technology stacks. With MCP, firms can integrate new solutions efficiently, drive innovation, and maximize the value of their financial operations—ensuring consistent, context-rich decision-making throughout the investment process.
payload.longDescription: FactSet 模型上下文协议（MCP）是一项开放、基于 API 的标准，旨在顺畅连接不同平台上的金融数据、分析模型和应用。MCP 通过实现顺畅互操作，让投资团队无论采用何种工具或技术栈，都能轻松分享洞察、简化工作流程并加强协作。借助 MCP，公司可高效整合新方案、推动创新，并充分发挥金融业务的价值，确保整个投资流程中的决策一致且拥有丰富的上下文。

payload.name: Mercury
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Mercury account to ChatGPT to get answers about your finances in the same place you’re already doing the rest of your work.
payload.longDescription: 将 Mercury 账户连接到 ChatGPT，在您已经处理其他工作的同一个地方，获得有关财务状况的答案。

payload.name: Remitly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You can use Remitly within Chatgpt to plan your money transfer before you send. You can ask questions about delivery times, fees, rates and more.

Remitly is trusted by millions of customers who rely on it to send money home, donate or have local currency while traveling abroad. Our customers and their recipients are located in over 170 countries across the globe, and Remitly offers 24/7 customer support.

payload.name: Rallies
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rallies is an AI research app for the stock market, built on live data instead of stale web results. Ask about any US ticker in plain English and get answers backed by real-time prices, fundamentals, earnings, SEC filings, options flow, technicals, analyst actions, insider activity, and hedge fund positioning.

Connect your brokerage to ask questions about your own portfolio; what drove today's move, where your risk concentrates, how a holding compares to its peers — without juggling six tabs or spreadsheets.

What you can do:

Work from live charts with indicators (RSI, MACD, 20/50 MA)
Analyze earnings history, estimates, and surprises
Screen by price action, fundamentals, or technical setups
Review options flow, darkpool prints, short interest, insider and politician trades
Track your net worth and holdings across connected accounts

Rallies is a research tool and does not execute trades.
payload.longDescription:
Rallies 是一款股票市场 AI 研究应用，基于实时数据而非过时的网络结果构建。用日常英语询问任意美国股票代码，获得基于实时价格、基本面、财报、SEC 申报文件、期权资金流、技术面、分析师行动、内部人士活动和对冲基金持仓的答案。

追踪已连接账户的净资产和持仓
关注 AI Arena，前沿模型在这里公开运行实盘投资组合，并透明展示推理过程

Rallies 是研究工具，不执行交易。

payload.name: Intuit TurboTax
payload.description: 税额估算、报税准备及专家服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get fast federal tax estimates and discover filing and preparation options with Intuit TurboTax-powered tools. Use a simple tax estimator or a guided interview to collect what matters, and watch your refund or amount owed update as you go. Get a clear view of the forms and documents you need, what you have, and what is left to gather—then upload securely when you sign in and complete consent when prompted for protected features. Ready for a human? Find trusted tax pros, check real availability, and book an appointment. Confident tax filing starts here.

payload.name: Pocket Ledger Expense Tracker

payload.name: InvestmentIQ

payload.name: StockLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StockLens scores 9,500+ stocks every night across five domains: Fundamental, Technical, Risk, Sentiment, and Macro. Ask about a stock and get its latest composite score, the domain scores behind it, and the strengths and challenges the scoring run surfaced. The 600 largest companies answer with no StockLens account and no sign-in. Free accounts read those same 600, Pro reads the top 5,000, and Max reads the whole scored universe. Any account also reads every stock on its own watchlist, however deep it ranks.

Find your next idea instead of checking one ticker at a time. Discover Stocks screens the whole nightly-analyzed universe by region, exchange, sector, industry, market cap, or volume and ranks the results by any StockLens score, so "the five highest-scored Technology stocks on NASDAQ" is a single question. Free accounts browse with scores hidden; Pro and Max plans include the ranked results.

Build and manage your own watchlist right from the conversation: add or remove a ticker, then ask how everything on it scored last night. Free tracks up to 10 stocks; Pro and Max plans track an unlimited number.

When one stock matters, start a full analysis on demand, follow its progress, and read the result. Plus Analysis adds an AI narrative and is part of the Pro and Max plans.

Try:

Analyses, discovery, and your watchlist connect to your StockLens account over OAuth. Plan changes are made by signing in at stocklens.com. For informational and educational purposes only, not investment advice.
payload.longDescription:

无需逐个检查股票代码，即可寻找下一个投资思路。Discover Stocks 可按地区、交易所、板块、行业、市值或成交量筛选每晚分析的全部股票，并按任意 StockLens 评分排序，因此只需一句“NASDAQ 上评分最高的五只科技股”。免费账户浏览时不显示评分；Pro 和 Max 套餐包含排序结果。

payload.name: Gainium

payload.name: Zacks Financial Data

Use Zacks Investment Research’s trusted data right in your AI chat — and give your AI assistant an edge. Zacks Connect AI is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that plugs the Zacks Rank, estimates, fundamentals, Zacks Investment Research and market news straight into your Claude chat.
Financial reported data, Zacks Ranks, Data history, daily prices, Analyst consensus , reasons to buy, investment ideas.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 AI 聊天中使用 Zacks Investment Research 的可信数据，让你的 AI 助手更具优势。Zacks Connect AI 是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，将 Zacks Rank、预测数据、基本面、Zacks Investment Research 和市场新闻直接接入你的 Claude 聊天。
财务报告数据、Zacks Ranks、历史数据、每日价格、分析师共识、买入理由和投资思路。

payload.name: WealthCheck Financial Planner

Whether you're budgeting for the first time or optimizing an existing plan, see exactly where your money goes and what to do next.

Tap into 11M+ double-validated company profiles, leading coverage of recent equity deals, proprietary taxonomies, unique scores, hidden signals, and over 20 years of bleeding edge technology research to identify and analyze relevant, high-potential companies ahead of your competition.

Built for corporate strategists seeking acquisition targets, VCs screening deal flow, and business development teams hunting new partners. If your work involves private companies, CB Insights delivers the insight you need to make your next move first.

专为寻找收购目标的企业战略人员、筛选投资项目的风投机构，以及寻觅新合作伙伴的业务拓展团队打造。如果你的工作涉及非上市公司，CB Insights 提供所需洞察，让你抢先采取下一步行动。

payload.name: Portfolio Dividend Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Portfolio Dividend Tracker helps users review portfolio holdings and performance, inspect market and cash-flow data, and manage transactions, dividends, expenses, bookings, cash corrections, and investment strategies through ChatGPT.

payload.name: TraderSpy
payload.description: 加密货币信号和鲸鱼数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TraderSpy connects ChatGPT to live crypto futures data, so you can ask about the market instead of tab-hopping between exchanges.

Ask what the AI signal engine has published for a coin and you get the entry, the take-profit ladder, the stop and what actually happened to earlier signals — not just a direction. Ask what the whales are doing and you get real positions held by top-performing traders on Binance, Hyperliquid, Bybit and OKX, plus a leaderboard scored on PnL, win rate, ROI and consistency. Prices, candles and 13 technical indicators are one question away, and with your own account connected you can ask how far a position sits from liquidation.

Every tool is read-only. TraderSpy cannot place, close or modify an order and has no withdrawal or transfer tool — it answers questions, you place your own trades. A free account is enough to start.
payload.longDescription:
TraderSpy 将 ChatGPT 连接到实时加密货币期货数据，让你直接询问市场情况，无需在不同交易所标签页间切换。

询问 AI 信号引擎对某个币种发布了什么，即可获得入场价、分级止盈价、止损价，以及此前信号的实际结果，而不仅仅是交易方向。询问鲸鱼在做什么，即可获得 Binance、Hyperliquid、Bybit 和 OKX 上表现优异交易者的真实持仓，以及根据盈亏、胜率、ROI 和稳定性评分的排行榜。只需一句提问，就能获取价格、K 线和 13 个技术指标；连接自己的账户后，还能询问持仓距离强制平仓有多远。

每个工具都是只读的。TraderSpy 无法下单、平仓或修改订单，也没有提现或转账工具——它回答问题，交易由你自己执行。免费账户即可开始使用。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Double manages the month-end close. It replaces spreadsheets and scattered checklists with a single system connected to your GL or ERP: tasks, team assignments, and close status all in one place.

Connect it to ChatGPT and you can act on your close without switching apps. Create and reassign tasks, turn meeting notes into action items, and draft status updates for your team or clients, with changes writing back to Double in real time. payload.longDescription:
Double 管理月末结账。它以连接总账（GL）或 ERP 的统一系统取代电子表格和分散的检查清单，将任务、团队分工和结账状态汇总到一处。

支持 QuickBooks、Xero、NetSuite 和 Sage Intacct。专为执行月末结账的记账人员、会计师及财务团队打造。

payload.name: XE Currency Converter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: XE Currency Converter handles any request to convert money between currencies, check a live exchange rate, or compare currency values. Use it for prompts like 'convert 100 USD to EUR', 'how much is 50 usd in inr', "what's the GBP to JPY rate right now", or '250 dollars in rupees' — with or without an explicit amount, and with currency codes in any case or written as names. Returns the converted amount and the current mid-market exchange rate.
payload.longDescription: XE Currency Converter 处理货币之间的金额换算、实时汇率查询或币值比较请求。可用于“将 100 USD 换算为 EUR”、“50 usd 等于多少 inr”、“现在 GBP 对 JPY 的汇率是多少”或“250 美元折合多少卢比”等提示——无论是否明确给出金额，货币代码使用任何大小写，或用货币名称书写，都可以处理。返回换算金额和当前市场中间汇率。

payload.name: Liberty Mutual
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Liberty Mutual is a leading national property & casualty insurer offering dependable auto insurance backed by decades of financial strength and customer service. With Liberty Mutual through ChatGPT you can get a fast, personalized auto insurance quote estimate by providing only a few simple details. 

No purchase is required to get estimates. By chatting with us through ChatGPT, the personal information you provide in this chat will be subject to ChatGPT Terms of Use and Privacy Policy and may be shared with Liberty Mutual, affiliates and service providers for the purpose of providing you with an auto insurance quote estimate. Please only share the personal information requested to the questions Liberty Mutual asks for providing you with a quote estimate. Please don’t provide any additional sensitive personal information. To learn more about how Liberty Mutual processes your personal information, please see our privacy policy.
payload.longDescription:

获取估算无需购买。通过 ChatGPT 与我们对话时，您在聊天中提供的个人信息受 ChatGPT 使用条款和隐私政策约束，并可能与 Liberty Mutual、其关联公司及服务提供商共享，用于为您提供汽车保险报价估算。请仅提供 Liberty Mutual 为生成报价估算而提出的问题所要求的个人信息。请勿提供额外的敏感个人信息。要了解 Liberty Mutual 如何处理您的个人信息，请参阅我们的隐私政策。

payload.name: Kick
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use MCP to connect ChatGPT to Kick to automate your accounting across your businesses and clients. Analyze your financial statements, categorize transactions, post journal entries, and close your books faster. ChatGPT drafts, you review and approve with confidence.
payload.longDescription: 使用 MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Kick，自动处理旗下企业和客户的会计事务。分析财务报表、分类交易、过账日记账分录，并更快完成结账。ChatGPT 起草，由你审阅并放心批准。

payload.name: RetirementIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get a fast, clear snapshot of how prepared you are for retirement—based on your age, income, and current savings. See an easy retirement “score,” an on-track status, and the key numbers to focus on next. Free to use right now for a limited time.
payload.longDescription: 根据年龄、收入和当前储蓄，快速清晰地了解你的退休准备程度。查看易于理解的退休“评分”、是否按计划推进的状态，以及接下来应关注的关键数字。目前限时免费使用。

payload.name: Buy Or Rent Simulator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.

By integrating historical and projected IMF inflation data for your specific country, the simulator tracks the real value of your money year after year. It provides a complete financial breakdown from your first mortgage payment to the final resale, ensuring you stay objective based on your unique project.

Key features:
- Uses country-specific IMF inflation data for realistic long-term projections
- Compares the cost of buying with potential returns of alternative investments (stock market, savings, etc.)
- No account or registration required — start simulating immediately
- Toggle advanced parameters and view a full amortization table to understand every payment of your mortgage

Adjustable parameters:
- Property: Purchase price, notary fees, renovation costs, and agency fees
- Financing: Down payment, loan duration, mortgage rate, insurance, and prepayment penalties
- Rental: Monthly rent and projected annual rent increases
- Market Logic: Resale horizon, country-specific inflation (IMF), and alternative investment yield
- Costs: Local property taxes and maintenance

Get a clear, visual report on your break-even point and see exactly when ownership starts to pay off.
payload.longDescription:
通过全面的买房与租房模拟器，作出充分知情的房地产决策。此应用提供客观、数据驱动的分析，判断购买房产是否确实比租房并将资金投向其他用途更划算。

模拟器结合你所在国家的 IMF 历史及预测通胀数据，逐年跟踪资金的实际价值。从首次偿还房贷到最终转售，它提供完整的财务分解，让你依据自身具体项目保持客观判断。

主要功能：
- 使用各国 IMF 通胀数据，进行贴近实际的长期预测
- 比较买房成本与其他投资（股市、储蓄等）的潜在回报
- 无需账户或注册，即可立即开始模拟
- 切换高级参数并查看完整摊还表，了解每笔房贷还款

可调整参数：
- 房产：购入价格、公证费、装修成本及中介费
- 融资：首付、贷款期限、房贷利率、保险及提前还款罚金
- 租赁：月租金及预计年度租金涨幅
- 市场逻辑：转售时间、各国通胀率（IMF）及其他投资收益率
- 成本：当地房产税及维护费用

获取清晰、直观的盈亏平衡点报告，准确了解何时持有房产开始带来收益。

All tools are read-only and return analyst-oriented summaries for research workflows.

payload.name: LendingTree
REPSLog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
REPSLog helps real estate professionals log and review the work hours that count toward Real Estate Professional Status (REPS) for U.S. tax purposes. Connect your REPSLog account and you can add a time log in plain language (for example, "log 2 hours showing the Oak Street property today"), then ask for your hours back by property, category, participant, or date range.

The connector can create a time log and read your existing data: list your properties, categories, and participants, pull individual logs, and get summaries of total hours. Everything is scoped to your own authenticated REPSLog account. It does not access or share other users' data.

Requires a REPSLog account with an active Premium subscription. That subscription is purchased separately in the standalone REPSLog mobile and web apps, not through ChatGPT. Logs created here sync to those apps, so your records stay in one place for IRS documentation.
payload.longDescription:
REPSLog 帮助房地产专业人士记录和查看计入美国税务用途的房地产专业人士身份（Real Estate Professional Status，REPS）的工作时数。连接 REPSLog 账户后，你可以用自然语言添加工时记录（例如“记录今天带人看 Oak Street 房产的 2 小时”），然后按房产、类别、参与者或日期范围查询工时。

该连接器可以创建工时记录并读取现有数据：列出你的房产、类别和参与者，获取单条记录，以及汇总总工时。所有操作均限于你自己经过身份验证的 REPSLog 账户。它不会访问或共享其他用户的数据。

需要拥有已开通 Premium 订阅的 REPSLog 账户。该订阅需在独立的 REPSLog 手机和网页应用中另行购买，而不是通过 ChatGPT 购买。在此创建的记录会同步至这些应用，让记录集中保存在一处，供 IRS 税务材料留存使用。

payload.name: ForInvest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Connect your AI assistant directly to the heartbeat of global financial markets. The Forinvest MCP (Model Context Protocol) app transforms ChatGPT into a powerful financial agent with 22 MCP tools, providing secure, low-latency access to:

Live Market Data: Instant access to BIST, VIOP, global indices, commodities, and crypto prices.

Advanced Analytics: Professional-grade technical analysis tools and financial indicators at your fingertips.

Smart Portfolio Insights: Seamlessly retrieve and analyze portfolio data with institutional precision.

Seamless Connectivity: Built on the MCP standard for secure, bidirectional communication between ChatGPT and Forinvest's robust financial infrastructure.

Whether you're tracking real-time price movements or seeking deep market analysis, Forinvest MCP provides the reliable data layer needed for informed decision-making.

We provide a next-generation financial ecosystem, offering real-time Borsa Istanbul (BIST) data, AI-driven stock analysis, and comprehensive financial tools. Our platform streamlines investment processes by integrating deep-dive balance sheet metrics, brokerage expectations, and instant access to public disclosure (KAP) documents.

Data collected: ForInvest account credentials (for OAuth authentication), symbol codes and date ranges you query, and session identifiers. Tool inputs and outputs are not stored beyond the active session. Financial data returned by tools is sent back to ChatGPT for display. No personal data is sold or used for advertising.

Privacy Policy: https://mcp.forinvest.com/privacy.html
payload.longDescription:
Forinvest MCP：实时市场情报与交易集成

将你的 AI 助手直接连接到全球金融市场的脉动。Forinvest MCP（模型上下文协议）应用利用 22 个 MCP 工具，将 ChatGPT 变成强大的金融智能体，为以下内容提供安全、低延迟的访问：

实时市场数据：即时获取 BIST、VIOP、全球指数、大宗商品和加密货币价格。

高级分析：随时使用专业级技术分析工具和金融指标。

智能投资组合洞察：以机构级精度顺畅获取和分析投资组合数据。

无缝连接：基于 MCP 标准，在 ChatGPT 与 Forinvest 强大的金融基础设施之间建立安全的双向通信。

无论是跟踪实时价格变动，还是寻求深入市场分析，Forinvest MCP 都能提供可靠的数据层，支持有依据的决策。

我们提供新一代金融生态系统，包括实时 Borsa Istanbul（BIST，伊斯坦布尔证券交易所）数据、AI 驱动的股票分析及全面的金融工具。平台整合深入的资产负债表指标、券商预期和即时访问公开披露（KAP）文件的能力，简化投资流程。

收集的数据：ForInvest 账户凭据（用于 OAuth 身份验证）、你查询的证券代码和日期范围，以及会话标识符。工具输入和输出不会在当前会话结束后继续保存。工具返回的金融数据会发送回 ChatGPT 以供展示。不出售个人数据，也不将其用于广告。

payload.name: Klardaten DATEV-Connector
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Klardaten DATEV-Connector gives authorized users controlled access to DATEV accounting, payroll (Lohn und Gehalt and LODAS), document management, order management, and master data through ChatGPT. It supports guided discovery, scoped list and detail lookups, financial reporting, DMS metadata and content search, document retrieval, order inspection, payroll snapshots, and master-data access. Large read results can be retrieved through authenticated attachments. With a separately approved OAuth permission, it can create uncommitted accounting sequences; it cannot finalize them. LODAS requires the exchange service to be enabled for the selected client. DMS content search is available only for eligible accounts. Access is limited to the DATEV data and operations permitted for the authenticated user.
payload.longDescription: Klardaten DATEV-Connector 让获授权用户通过 ChatGPT 受控访问 DATEV 会计、工资（Lohn und Gehalt 和 LODAS）、文档管理、订单管理及主数据。它支持引导式发现、限定范围的列表与详情查询、财务报告、DMS 元数据和内容搜索、文档获取、订单查看、工资快照及主数据访问。较大的读取结果可通过经过身份验证的附件获取。获得单独批准的 OAuth 权限后，它可以创建尚未提交的会计序列，但不能最终确认这些序列。LODAS 要求为选定客户启用交换服务。DMS 内容搜索仅适用于符合条件的账户。访问范围仅限已认证用户获准使用的 DATEV 数据和操作。

payload.name: GoCardless
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your GoCardless account to look up payments, customers, mandates, payouts, and refunds, and to take actions such as creating payments, issuing refunds and cancelling mandates.

You choose what permissions to authorise when you connect. Money-moving actions show a preview and wait for your confirmation. Sensitive data such as customer email addresses are partly hidden before the model sees them. Bank account details are never shared.

Building on the GoCardless API? Ask for integration guidance and code samples, and connect to Sandbox to test.
payload.longDescription:
连接 GoCardless 账户，查询付款、客户、扣款授权、结算款和退款，并执行创建付款、发起退款及取消扣款授权等操作。

连接时由你选择授权哪些权限。涉及资金转移的操作会展示预览，并等待你的确认。客户邮箱等敏感数据在模型看到之前会被部分隐藏。银行账户详情绝不共享。

正在使用 GoCardless API 开发？可以索取集成指导和代码示例，并连接 Sandbox 进行测试。

payload.name: Octus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Octus' verified credit intelligence directly in Claude and other LLMs. The Octus MCP Connector™ delivers proprietary intel, issuer fundamentals, private data room documents and covenant analysis across 95%+ of the sub-investment grade credit universe. Query permissioned content in real time using natural language, power autonomous agent workflows and ground your AI systems in a trusted, standardized data source. Built for investment managers, banks, law firms and advisors who need research-grade answers at the speed of the market.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 Claude 及其他大语言模型中访问 Octus 已核实的信贷情报。Octus MCP Connector™ 提供专有情报、发行人基本面、私有数据室文档及契约条款分析，覆盖 95%+ 的非投资级信贷市场。使用自然语言实时查询具有访问权限的内容，支持自主智能体工作流，并让 AI 系统以可信、标准化的数据源为基础。专为需要以市场速度获取研究级答案的投资管理人、银行、律师事务所及顾问打造。

payload.name: Harmonic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, enrich, and research startups, companies and investors using Harmonic's proprietary data on millions of companies and the people behind them. Get detailed company profiles with funding, location, founders, and network connections. Use natural language to find companies matching specific criteria. Create and manage lists of companies and people. Access your team's network mapping and saved searches. Discover startups earlier, research them faster, and act with confidence—an AI-powered research agent built into your workflow.
payload.longDescription: 利用 Harmonic 关于数百万家企业及其背后人员的专有数据，搜索、补充和研究初创公司、企业及投资者。获取包含融资、所在地、创始人及人脉关系的详细企业资料。使用自然语言查找符合特定条件的企业。创建和管理企业与人员列表。访问团队的人脉关系图及已保存的搜索。更早发现初创公司、更快开展研究并有把握地行动——这是融入您工作流程的 AI 研究智能体。

payload.name: Boleron AI Insurance Broker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare real-time insurance prices from top carriers in Bulgaria. Instantly calculate vehicle motor third-party liability (MTPL / Гражданска отговорност) and travel insurance rates tailored to your specific needs.

The app generates instant price comparisons, detailed coverage limits, policy exclusions, and key product features across multiple insurers to help you evaluate options before you buy.

Ideal for checking car liability pricing or planning travel coverage inside the chat. To get a final legally binding offer and complete your transaction, you can seamlessly transfer your vehicle or trip parameters to boleron.bg
payload.longDescription:
比较保加利亚领先保险公司的实时保险价格。根据具体需求，即时计算机动车第三者责任险（MTPL / Гражданска отговорност）和旅行保险费率。

应用即时生成多家保险公司的价格对照、详细保障限额、免责条款和主要产品特点，帮助你在购买前评估选择。

适合在聊天中查看汽车责任险价格或规划旅行保障。要获取最终具有法律约束力的报价并完成交易，可顺畅地将车辆或行程参数传至 boleron.bg。

payload.name: Any Exchange Rate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Toggle between exchange rates and convert different amounts without having to leave ChatGPT.

e.g. Just ask ChatGPT: "@Any Exchange Rate How much is 300 dollars in euros?"

Once the app is open, switch amounts or currencies, then carry on chatting- the model will be updated with the final figures.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可切换汇率并换算不同金额。

例如，只需问 ChatGPT：“@Any Exchange Rate 300 美元等于多少欧元？”

打开应用后，切换金额或币种，然后继续聊天，模型会收到最终数值更新。

payload.name: Chronograph LP
payload.description: 值得信赖的投资组合数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Chronograph LP provides portfolio monitoring and analytics solutions for private capital investors. Through the Chronograph LP App within ChatGPT and Codex, users can access the full depth of their trusted private markets portfolio data using natural language, from underlying portfolio companies and assets to funds, vehicles, commitments, and more.

Chronograph provides two separate Apps for different client user types: Chronograph LP for Limited Partner users and Chronograph GP for General Partner users.
payload.longDescription:
Chronograph LP 为私募资本投资者提供投资组合监测和分析解决方案。通过 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中的 Chronograph LP 应用，用户可使用自然语言全面访问可信赖的私募市场投资组合数据，从底层被投公司和资产，到基金、投资载体、认缴承诺等。

Chronograph 为不同类型的客户用户提供两个独立应用：面向有限合伙人用户的 Chronograph LP，以及面向普通合伙人用户的 Chronograph GP。

payload.name: Bankrate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This tool specializes in providing current consumer banking rates and calculating savings projections. It is designed to be an objective, non-advisory resource.
payload.longDescription: 此工具专门提供当前面向消费者的银行利率，并计算储蓄预测。它旨在成为客观且不提供咨询建议的信息资源。

payload.name: Zocks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zocks connects to the client data financial advisors rely on - including conversation intelligence, meeting insights, and the goals, concerns, and planning opportunities captured across every interaction. With access to this context through Zocks, you can analyze client history to surface tax considerations, estate planning signals, and other client-specific insights advisors may want to explore further.
payload.longDescription: Zocks 连接财务顾问所依赖的客户数据，包括对话情报、会议洞见，以及在每次互动中捕捉的目标、顾虑和规划机会。通过 Zocks 访问这些上下文后，你可以分析客户历史，发现税务考量、遗产规划信号，以及顾问可能希望进一步探索的其他客户专属洞见。

payload.name: Freeway Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get an estimated auto insurance rate through a simple conversation. Answer a few questions about yourself, your drivers, and your vehicles, then continue with Freeway for a more detailed quote.
payload.longDescription: 通过简单对话获得汽车保险费率估算。回答几个关于你本人、驾驶人和车辆的问题，再前往 Freeway 获取更详细的报价。

payload.name: Mashvisor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mashvisor helps users search investment properties, inspect listing details and photos, and compare Traditional vs Airbnb cash-flow projections using Mashvisor market data.
payload.longDescription: Mashvisor 帮助用户搜索投资房产、查看房源详情和照片，并利用 Mashvisor 市场数据，比较传统出租与 Airbnb 出租的现金流预测。
